slug: ydb-core
description: Use for YDB introductions and comparisons with other databases; connection strings, authentication, service-account credentials and credential environment variables; local Docker; SDK/package/integration selection; CLI discovery and safe namespace operations with `ydb scheme` (inspection, creation, removal, permissions, confirmation); client-side balancing, session lifecycle under rolling restart, and general deadline, cancellation, or retry-budget guidance outside application-query audits. Applies to explanatory questions as well as setup tasks. Triggers include `grpcs://`, `grpc://`, `ydb --help`, `ydb version`, `ydb config`, `ydb discovery`, `ydb scheme`, `balancers.RandomChoice`, `balancers.PreferNearestDC`, `ydb.WithBalancer`, `session-balancer`, `BAD_SESSION`, and `shutdownHint`. Use ydb-table for SQL, query execution, schema design for queries, and application query-code audits; use specialist skills for topic or coordination tasks.

slug: ydb-docs
description: Find and verify official documentation for the YDB database (СУБД YDB) on ydb.tech. Use for YDB documentation lookup, source links, citations, fact checking, and lookup plans without network access. Can support another YDB skill when documentation is needed. Supports Russian or English and requested product versions. This is specific to the YDB database, not a general YQL documentation tool; YT/Hahn is outside its scope.

slug: ydb-table
description: Write, explain, and audit YDB table queries, schemas, and data access. Use for YQL pagination, primary keys and partitioning, query parameters, `ydb sql`, SQL-to-YQL conversion, and reviews of Java JDBC/Hibernate/Spring Data configuration or write patterns, Go query/transaction handlers, and C++ query/retry code. Includes caller deadline and cancellation propagation in query code and Python FloatVector parameter encoding. Use ydb-core for connection/authentication, SDK selection, or general client policy without a query/code audit. YQL on YT alone is outside this skill.
